lines.en: I crawl quick and low along the ground.
Acid gurgles in my throat.
I lurch, yet I move fast.
A wet trail drags behind my feet.
I slip along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 腐败的气味跟在我后面
lines.en: The reek of rot follows me.

lines.zh: 我把头低着，省得被看见
lines.en: I keep my head low so I'm unseen.

lines.zh: 草丛一响，我就换个方向
lines.en: A rustle in the grass and I change course.

lines.zh: 我的手指在地上刨出浅沟
lines.en: My fingers gouge shallow furrows.
Fast enough that you can't draw in time.
I walk with my head askew, neck clicking.
Acid drips from me as I walk.

lines.zh: 我把半边身子埋进土里
lines.en: I sink half my body into the soil.
Only my eyes stay above ground.
I wait, very quietly.
The dirt covers my smell.
I listen for footsteps.
That acid keeps rising in my throat.

lines.zh: 我的视线不太好，靠听的
lines.en: My sight is poor; I rely on hearing.
When the wind stops, I surface.
A stone under the earth jabs my ribs.
I wait for someone to come near.

lines.zh: 我从地底钻出来，正对你的脸。
lines.en: I rise from underground, face to face with you.

lines.zh: 你没看见我刚才在土里
lines.en: You didn't see me down in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里什么也没有
lines.en: There's nothing in my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙鼓起来，酸液在里头响。
lines.en: My throat swells, acid gurgling inside.
You're standing close. Good.
I tilt my head, as if hearing your heart.

lines.zh: 酸液在我嘴里转了一圈
lines.en: Acid rolls around my mouth.
Your bow — you can't draw it now.
I take one step forward.
You should have found me sooner.
The blow flattens me to the ground.
I cough up a mouthful of acid.

lines.zh: 我的脖子歪得更厉害了
lines.en: My neck twists further askew.
A chunk of rotten flesh drops off.
I don't cry out; I just twitch.

lines.zh: 这一下让我缩进了土里
lines.en: That one sends me shrinking into the dirt.
I pull back, but not from fear.
My throat is blocked for now.
You hit my shoulder.
I'll be back. From below.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，我闻到了
lines.en: I smell that bit in your hand.

lines.zh: 腐烂的东西才合我胃口
lines.en: Only rotten things suit my appetite.
Fresh things taste wrong to me.
I come slowly. Don't move.
Acid will soften it. Less work.
I'm not fussy. If it's edible, fine.
Why retreat? I don't bite.

lines.zh: 我把脖子探出地面，嗅着血味。
lines.en: I stretch my neck from the ground, sniffing blood.
Let me taste it and I'll know.
Put it down and walk away. Don't look back.
Hit me and your armour will clang.
I'm sticky. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了一下，很快站住
lines.en: I'm knocked askew, then right myself.
At the impact I spat acid.
You backed off; the acid still smokes.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住了你的袖子
lines.en: My hand caught your sleeve.
Don't hug the wall. I'm faster there.
That bump annoyed me.
You stepped in my trail.

lines.zh: 再碰我，我就往你脸上吐
lines.en: Touch me again and I spit in your face.
Two hollows in the dirt are enough.
Buried side by side, we're safe.
My burrow is deep. Come in.

lines.zh: 腐臭混在一起，就不显眼
lines.en: Our rot blends together; less noticeable.
You needn't fear this face.
We'll go out when it's dark.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的酸分你一半
lines.en: I'll share the acid in my throat.
Not too close; I can't control it.
I like the quiet under the ground.
Together we'll wait for someone careless.
I scrape it down into the dirt.
This fits into my acid sac.
I take it up and swallow slowly.
Bone. I'll keep it.
Whatever falls, I take.

lines.zh: 我把它埋起来，回头再取
lines.en: I bury it and come back later.
An acid bowl — I know how to make one.
You dropped it; I picked it up faster.
I weigh it. Not heavy.
What I take stays taken.
Your footsteps gave you away.

lines.zh: 我听见了，所以找到你了
lines.en: I heard it, and that's how I found you.

lines.zh: 从地下上来，正好在你身后
lines.en: Up from the ground, right behind you.
First a spit, to test the distance.
You draw that bow far too slowly.
I fix on your shadow.
The acid has pooled in my mouth.
Run. I crawl faster than you.
This step is meant for you.
Don't look back. Too late.

lines.zh: 你脚下的土，被我的舌头舔到了。
lines.en: My tongue has already tasted the soil at your feet.
My throat is swelling.
Within thirty paces, you can't escape.
I've marked where you stand.
Let's begin. No more waiting.
I crawl around your shadow.
You retreat; I follow along the ground.
I'm hunting an angle to spit from.
The seams in your armour are wide.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，听你的呼吸
lines.en: I pause and listen to your breathing.
Your footsteps are too regular.

lines.zh: 我从左边绕，你看着右边
lines.en: I circle left while you watch right.
I've been holding this acid a long time.
You raise the shield, so I aim low.
Don't lean on that trunk.
I close the distance step by step.
You're panting. I don't breathe.
One more step and we're there.
I've been below you the whole time.
Your shadow gave you away.
This one is for your face.

lines.zh: 你听不见我爬的声音吗
lines.en: Can't you hear me crawl?
Right here. I've arrived.
A jet of acid hits your chest.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抠进你的护腕
lines.en: My claws dig into your bracer.
White smoke rises off your armour.
I lunge and pin your leg.
This spit lands before your feet.
You dodged the acid, not me.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿咬住你的袖口
lines.en: My teeth clamp your cuff.
The sound of corrosion is soft.
You fall back; I crawl after.

lines.zh: 这一口的距离算得很准
lines.en: That spit was measured exactly.
There's a hole in your wrist now.
Another. I'm not done spitting.
My head dips — here it comes again.
You guard your face; I strike your gut.
You should have kept your distance.
The acid got into the seam.

lines.zh: 土面鼓起一块，我钻出来
lines.en: The soil bulges and I come out.
Head first, then hands.
Wet mud still clings to me.
The ground here suits me well.
There's a living smell in the air.

lines.zh: 我把喉咙里的酸咽回去
lines.en: I swallow the acid back down.
My sight is bad, but enough.

lines.zh: 没有目标的白天，我躲着
lines.en: By day, with no target, I hide.

lines.zh: 草丛后面有个洞，那是我的
lines.en: That hole behind the grass is mine.
I've crawled out of the rotten earth.
Don't stand on soft ground.
I'm here. From below.
I'm counting the footsteps above.

lines.zh: 这一片土，我都钻得进去
lines.en: I can get into any soil here.
Fire catches and I dry like kindling.
I drop into a pit and a bone slips out.

lines.zh: 水泡软了我，我浮不起来
lines.en: Water softens me and I can't rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得翻了个身
lines.en: The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我背上，我拖着走
lines.en: An arrow in my back drags as I move.
That light sears my eyes shut.
Too starved to spit even acid.

lines.zh: 雷打在土上，我整具身子都僵了
lines.en: Lightning hits the soil and my whole body stiffens.
I fall into a dark with no soil.
